Hymn 55: Lo, the Mighty God Appearing!
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: William Goode
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 55 titled "Lo, the Mighty God Appearing!" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by William Goode.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
